issues.title: Inverted JSON syntax under RTL
issues.description: JSON key-value pairs, braces, and guide lines are improperly mirrored, breaking code readability.
issues.evidence: Braces are inverted ({ at bottom, } at top), keys and values are swapped, and the tree guide line is isolated on the far left.
issues.suggestion: Enforce LTR text direction on code and JSON tree containers.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: Branch/Leaf inherit page dir, so under RTL the flex row order reverses (keys/values swap, braces mirror) and the physical border-l/pl-4/ml-[7px] indent rail strands on the far left; JSON is inherently LTR — enforce dir="ltr" on node roots and switch the indent rail to logical properties.
